svg.title: Underfilled square collimated beam
svg.desc: A collimated 30 by 30 millimetre square beam expands to a 42.43 by 30 millimetre footprint on a 45 degree splitter, fits within the clear aperture, and remains 30 by 30 millimetres after reflection.
svg.text: Case 1 — underfilled square: reflection preserves 30 × 30 mm
ideal centred collimated beam; planes shown normal to each chief ray except the middle splitter-plane footprint

g.data-original-text: <text x="135" y="294" text-anchor="middle" class="strong">Wf × Wp = 30 × 30 mm</text>
g.title: Wf × Wp = 30 × 30 mm

g.data-original-text: <text x="400" y="329" text-anchor="middle" class="small">Wfootprint = Wf / |cos θ| = 30 / cos 45°</text>
g.title: Wfootprint = Wf / |cos θ| = 30 / cos 45°

g.data-original-text: <text x="665" y="294" text-anchor="middle" class="strong">Wf,out × Wp,out = 30 × 30 mm</text>
g.title: Wf,out × Wp,out = 30 × 30 mm

svg.text: no clipping; shape and size preserved
